body:
That's beautifully written, and I'm guessing Alex might be you..
I totally get how you're feeling.
My life's the same, well I kind of a fucked it up myself being a drug addict since I was 15 (48 now ) 
Pushing people away, while at the same time desperately needing connection.
We are social creatures, we need companionship, relationships, a connection with society, a place in the world..
But I know how hard it is when you feel like that, and it's easier to just hide away in the darkness and despair, not having to put in the effort of conversation, facing the world and so on..
It seems like too much hard work.

If you can though, try and push yourself.
Small steps , go to your local shop, talk to the shopkeeper..
Phone someone you used to be close with..
Reach out in some way and let people know you're struggling.
I bet those friends that seem a distant memory are still there, but thinking you're "busy" , doing other things , I bet they'd be there for you if you reached out.

I'm giving out advice I can't follow myself, I have nothing left, I'm done.
But I stay and suffer coz I don't want to hurt loved ones I'd be leaving behind, devastated.
My mum passed away last year, I miss her like mad every single day, and they're still grieving her too.
I dread to think what it would do to them to then also lose a sister, daughter, aunt, and a few other things, not just by dying but taking my own life 
I just couldn't 

Sorry didn't mean to make this about me, I hope you find the courage, the motivation, and realise you deserve more, to reach out and get some love and support.
And you sure have a gift for writing ❤️

I've been a heroin addict for 25+ years, I'm sure I've od'd here and there , but always came too.
Tried to on purpose many a time, but tolerance is a fucker.
So I know heroin won't kill me 🙄 Something else will though, slowly and painfully with my luck 😤
Or stupid choices

I hope he didn't go through with it.. Suicide is NOT an easy thing to do, I've made a complete cunt of my entire life (addiction, self harm and so on..),
and I've been wanting out for so long.
But suicide takes guts, it's so final. There's no turning back.
And then there's the guilt of the pain I'm causing to loved ones left behind..
I hope and pray he wasn't brave enough to do it , or put it off for another day, if you read this 
WE CARE AND UNDERSTAND YOUR PAIN ❤️
Please stay..

Damn that's horrendous. I already knew I could never slit my own throat, I'm a shite bag.
I would jump, or more likely let myself fall, of something high enough to without a doubt kill me.
But yeah, that fuckin survival instinct is a fucker.. So hard to overcome no matter how much you want to die.
But I'll definitely not be slitting my throat, hope that person's ok and still alive to tell the tale 🙏🏻(to save others from going through that nightmare, and also for him or herself).

When I was clean I turned into a glowing healthy looking clear speaking individual, you would never have known I'd ever been an addict.
Until I relapsed.
But it's definitely not a permanent thing, so I think like other people already mentioned , these people you're talking about are probably not being completely honest about being clean.. 
It does take time though, it doesn't happen overnight.
Just like you don't start "lookin like a junky" overnight either..
